cdxgen.notes: Arguments mirror BF-CBOM's cdxgen worker. Records source files in properties[].SrcFile without line numbers. Invoked through the image in `image`, the 12.8.2 tag pinned by digest, so it needs no build root and runs the same on any host with Docker.

pqprobe.notes: Exit 1 means findings present, not failure. The binary path comes from PQPROBE_BIN; the manifest records what it resolved to and that file's sha256. Maintained by the maintainer of Proofstein (METHODOLOGY.md §9).
